activity.role: United States Army soldier and officer
activity.notes: U.S. Army and Arlington National Cemetery sources document Audie Murphy's World War II Army service beginning in 1942, combat with the 15th Infantry Regiment of the 3rd Infantry Division, and release from active Army service on 21 September 1945. ATLAS stores the bounded 1942-1945 wartime service interval rather than later celebrity activity or inflated anecdotal claims.

sources.title: Biography of Sergeant Audie Murphy
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Army biography records Murphy's enlistment during World War II, assignment to the 15th Infantry Regiment, combat service across the Mediterranean and European theaters, and his release from active service on 21 September 1945.

sources.title: Audie Murphy - Arlington National Cemetery
sources.citation_text: Arlington National Cemetery records Murphy's 1942 Army enlistment and his subsequent World War II combat service with the 15th Regiment, 3rd Infantry Division.
